summary: The v1 answer-support review is reused for 17 unchanged-key cases; v2 corrects i008 by explicitly stating that only active attendees are eligible, so its keyed earliest-eligible decision is now supported. Five current path-target feedback messages describe a stub although their options do not: i008, i009, i012, i014, and i018. Those explanations diagnose a different action than the selected wrong option and must be aligned to the actual option. Other current feedback targets are valid and case-specific. Reason duplicates the first two Details fields in 17 items; additional Details fields provide application/tradeoff/transfer, so I note redundancy but do not count it as a separate blocker.
